details:
Q1: Which area should be improved?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase; name it and describe the problem. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Overall pipeline reliability or performance.
C. Documentation or developer experience.
Q2: What outcome should define “better”?
Choices:
A. Fix a defect; provide actual behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction steps. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add or change behavior; provide acceptance criteria.
C. Optimize a measurable result; provide the metric and target.
